children: The Korea-US Strategic Investment Corporation (KUIC) plans to issue dollar bonds next year to finance US investment projects under a $350 billion investment pledge last year, a senior finance ministry official said.
"A request for guarantee agreement has been submitted to parliament for issuance next year," the official said, adding no details have been finalised regarding the timing and size of issuance.
"It is a newly created corporation and there are procedures, so we are tapping markets," the official said.
The KUIC was established in June to oversee the government's investments in the US under a trade deal reached with Washington last year.

South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Friday that concerns over the commercial viability of a planned US investment package had become a sticking point in negotiations, although the two sides were nearing an agreement.
